name: Eliam Merick

abilities.name: Thunderous Entrance
abilities.description: Eliam Merick jumps down from his ledge to start the fight, creating a moderate shockwave around him, indicated by a circular AoE, dealing moderate physical damage and staggering you if close.

abilities.name: Axe Strike
abilities.description: A basic melee attack dealing moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Stomp
abilities.description: Eliam Merick swiftly stomps the ground, sending shockwaves forward from the impact point, indicated by small circular AoEs, dealing high physical damage and launching you backwards.

abilities.name: Heinous Highkick
abilities.description: A melee heavy attack where the boss will kick whoever holds aggro. If taunted this should just be the tank. He shares this ability with Prior Thierric Sarazen.

abilities.name: Golden Stomp
abilities.description: Eliam Merick slowly winds up his foot before stomping the ground, causing a burst of golden energy, indicated by a large growing circular AoE, dealing high magical damage. The impact point remains affected by lingering magic, dealing continuous moderate magical damage.

abilities.name: Charge
abilities.description: Eliam Merick brings his shield up and charges forward, indicated by a circular AoE beneath him, dealing high physical damage and knocking you down.

abilities.name: Allies Resurrection
abilities.description: When Eliam Merick reaches 35% health, if Ihudir and Liramindrel are dead, Eliam resurrects them both back to full health so that they can continue assisting him.

dialogue.speaker: Prior Thierric Sarazen
dialogue.line: Does the heathen priest believe he can stand in the way of our divine purpose?

dialogue.speaker: Liramindrel
dialogue.line: The powers of Oblivion aren't to be worshiped, they are to be commanded!

dialogue.speaker: Ihudir
dialogue.line: Two shares of the spoils for me, me.

dialogue.speaker: Eliam Merick
dialogue.line: I got this! There won't be much left after I stomp them into paste.
I can see you trembling. Or is it the boots?
I've been waiting to break in these boots. Though most of the breaking will be happening to you.
Come on, you cowards! I'm even letting you make the first move!
I'm looking forward to stomping all over you!
Don't worry, I'll try to save a couple for you two to play with.
Can't wait to see what happens after a swift kick between the legs with these.
You'll feel this in your bones!

dialogue.speaker: Eliam Merick
dialogue.trigger: At (?)% he will call for assistance

dialogue.speaker: Liramindrel
dialogue.line: Biting off more than you can chew, Eliam? No surprise there.
dialogue.trigger: At (?)% he will call for assistance

dialogue.speaker: Eliam Merick
dialogue.line: Rally! We can't loose to these heathens!
dialogue.trigger: At 35% he will raise the other two if they have been defeated and say

related_quests: A Rose of Many Thorns: A knightly order has been hoarding dangerous relics, and Lyranth wishes to claim one.
Pledge: Red Petal Bastion: Enter Red Petal Bastion and return Undaunted.
summary: Eliam Merick is a Breton found in Red Petal Bastion. He is equipped with the Groundsplitters and accompanied by Ihudir and Liramindrel, who together make up the second boss of the dungeon as the Artifact Bearers.
